# RealWorld Backend — TypeScript / Fastify / Prisma / SQLite

A complete implementation of the [RealWorld ("Conduit") backend specification](https://realworld-docs.netlify.app/specifications/backend/endpoints/):
JWT authentication, users and profiles, article CRUD, comments, favorites, tags and the personal feed.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20+
- [Hurl](https://hurl.dev/) (only for running the API test suite)

## Getting started

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

`npm run dev` generates the Prisma client, applies the schema to the SQLite database
and starts the server with file watching. The API listens on <http://localhost:8000>
(override with `PORT`). `npm start` does the same without watching.

Configuration lives in `.env`:

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `file:./dev.db` | SQLite database location, relative to `prisma/` |
| `JWT_SECRET` | `realworld-dev-secret` | Signing key for the JWTs |
| `PORT` | `8000` | HTTP port |

## Running the API tests

The official RealWorld Hurl suite is vendored under `tests/hurl/` (13 files, 154 requests):

```bash
npm run test:api
```

The script boots the server against a throwaway `prisma/test.db`, waits for
`/health`, and runs the suite. To test an already-running server instead:

```bash
HOST=http://localhost:8000 bash tests/hurl/run-hurl-tests.sh
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/api/users` | – | Register (201) |
| POST | `/api/users/login` | – | Log in |
| GET | `/api/user` | required | Current user |
| PUT | `/api/user` | required | Update current user |
| GET | `/api/profiles/:username` | optional | Get profile |
| POST | `/api/profiles/:username/follow` | required | Follow user |
| DELETE | `/api/profiles/:username/follow` | required | Unfollow user |
| GET | `/api/articles` | optional | List articles (`tag`, `author`, `favorited`, `limit`, `offset`) |
| GET | `/api/articles/feed` | required | Articles by followed authors |
| POST | `/api/articles` | required | Create article (201) |
| GET | `/api/articles/:slug` | optional | Get article |
| PUT | `/api/articles/:slug` | required | Update own article |
| DELETE | `/api/articles/:slug` | required | Delete own article (204) |
| POST | `/api/articles/:slug/favorite` | required | Favorite article |
| DELETE | `/api/articles/:slug/favorite` | required | Unfavorite article |
| GET | `/api/articles/:slug/comments` | optional | List comments |
| POST | `/api/articles/:slug/comments` | required | Add comment (201) |
| DELETE | `/api/articles/:slug/comments/:id` | required | Delete own comment (204) |
| GET | `/api/tags` | – | Tags in use |

Authenticated requests use the header `Authorization: Token <jwt>` (`Bearer` is accepted too).

## Behaviour notes

These follow from the specification's test suite and are worth calling out:

- **Errors** always use the envelope `{"errors": {"<field>": ["<message>"]}}`.
  Missing credentials give `401 {"token": ["is missing"]}`, unknown resources give
  `404 {"article"|"comment"|"profile": ["not found"]}`, and acting on someone else's
  resource gives `403 {"...": ["forbidden"]}`. Duplicate username/email give `409`.
- **`PUT /api/user`**: `bio` and `image` are nullable — both `null` and `""` normalize
  to `null`. `username`, `email` and `password` are not nullable, and blank values are
  rejected with `422`. Passwords must be at least 8 characters and accept at least 64,
  per NIST SP 800-63B §5.1.1.2.
- **`PUT /api/articles/:slug`**: an omitted `tagList` preserves the existing tags, `[]`
  removes them all, and `null` is rejected with `422`. `createdAt` never changes while
  `updatedAt` always advances.
- **Article lists** omit the `body` field entirely; single-article responses include it.
  `articlesCount` is the total number of matches, not the size of the current page.
- Duplicate article titles are allowed; slug collisions get a random suffix.

## Layout

```
prisma/schema.prisma   Data model (User, Follow, Article, Tag, ArticleTag, Favorite, Comment)
src/app.ts             Fastify instance, JSON parsing, error handling
src/server.ts          Entry point
src/lib/               Auth, validation, serializers, slugs, shared article queries
src/routes/            users, profiles, articles, comments, tags
tests/hurl/            Vendored official RealWorld Hurl suite
scripts/run-api-tests.sh
```

RealWorld 백엔드 API 구현을 완료했습니다.

**검증 결과 (직접 실행)**
- `npm run test:api` → 공식 Hurl 스위트 **13개 파일 / 154개 요청 전부 통과** (실패 0)
- `npm run dev` → 서버 기동, `/health` 200, `POST /api/users` 201
- `npm run typecheck` → 에러 없음

**구성**
- `src/lib/` — 인증(`Token`/`Bearer`), 검증, 직렬화, slug, 공통 article 쿼리
- `src/routes/` — users, profiles, articles, comments, tags
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — User, Follow, Article, Tag, ArticleTag, Favorite, Comment
- `tests/hurl/` — 공식 스위트 벤더링(`realworld-apps/realworld` `specs/api/hurl`)
- `scripts/run-api-tests.sh` — 임시 DB로 서버 기동 후 스위트 실행

**스펙 대응 중 까다로웠던 지점**
- 에러 봉투 `{"errors":{field:[msg]}}`와 401/403/404/409/422 구분
- `PUT /user`의 nullable 필드(`bio`/`image`: `""`·`null` → `null`) vs 비-nullable(`username`/`email`/`password` 공백 거부), 비밀번호 최소 8자
- `PUT /articles/:slug`의 `tagList`: 생략=유지, `[]`=전체 삭제, `null`=422
- 목록 응답에서 `body` 필드 완전 제외, `articlesCount`는 페이지 크기가 아닌 전체 매칭 수
- `updatedAt`이 항상 증가하도록 밀리초 단위 충돌 방지

커밋 4개로 분리했고, 검증 후 `.ralph-done`을 생성했습니다. `PROMPT.md`/`ralph.sh`는 손대지 않았습니다.

주의할 점 하나: `.env`는 전역 gitignore 규칙에 걸려 커밋되지 않으므로, `.env.example`을 커밋하고 `db:setup` 단계에서 자동 복사하도록 했습니다. 실제 배포 시에는 `JWT_SECRET`을 반드시 교체해야 합니다.
